source: National List of Essential Medicines (NLEM) 2022, Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Government of India. Released 13 September 2022.
transcription: Section-wise compilation of medicine names, without levels of care or dosage forms. Supplied with the caveat that it is not a verified one-to-one reconciliation of the official 384 entries, and that combinations and repeats across sections still need reconciling. Where a medicine also appears in the detailed files for Sections 1-7, that detail is authoritative.
